text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the matter, Boss?! What on earth 
is with all these vegetables...?

I explained that the vegetables were a 
gift from a farmer Fenomeno had helped in 
the past.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... To go out of your way to bring so 
much. I can't thank you enough!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since we're here, would it be 
alright if I did the cooking?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There's a specialty dish passed down from 
my mother that I've loved ever since I was 
little!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
With all my daily gratitude, I truly want 
you to taste this, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, let us borrow the 
cafeteria kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting! This is our 
family's pride and joy!

What was served was a heaping pile of 
steamed vegetables cut into thick rounds.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Bigger pieces have a better texture 
and let you really savor the natural 
flavor of the ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It has been seasoned with salt, but please 
enjoy it with any seasoning of your 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's dig in while it's hot.
choice_data_list:
Are you going to eat all of this right 
now?

Are you going to eat all of this right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I thought it would taste better 
piping hot... May I not eat it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Embarrassingly enough, my stomach's been 
grumbling ever since I started cooking...
choice_data_list:
Shall we share some with everyone else 
too?
Alright fine, you can eat it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !? That's right!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Since these are such wonderful vegetables, 
they'll definitely taste better if we all 
eat them together, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Then I'll go call them right away!

We shared the steamed vegetables together 
and thoroughly savored every bite.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Then I shall partake 
without hesitation, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not quite on Mom's level, I'm 
confident it turned out delicious!

And so, the two of us savored the steamed 
vegetables until we were completely full.
